prompt:
Create a photorealistic isolated BMW X3 G48 LONG five-door SUV using these three licensed images in the strict roles below. Make one new, coherent balanced front three-quarter view between a front one-third and front one-half view, with the nose pointing left. Keep the long rear doors and actual G48 long-body proportions, not a standard short G45. The result must show the full front and full body together through one camera.

Image 1 is the authoritative real dark navy/near-black car. Preserve its glossy metallic paint, complex dark-and-silver angular alloy wheels, whole tires and steering angle, body-colored handles and normally outward near mirror, visible window state and orange interior. Keep its actual BMW roundels, headlamps, grille perimeter, bumper and source-visible small fender M emblem. Preserve the darker finish of its front surfaces and corner L-shaped trim. The real large paired kidneys have vertical and diagonal strips: keep that structure, including the upper strips, with the subdued dark/silver finish seen in image 1. Do not replace it with a blank opaque panel or erase the diagonal bars. Do not brighten the corner trim or silver-coat the grille because another reference is brighter.

Image 2 shows the exact same plate and dark car from the rear. Use it only to complete the actual tail contour, stock roof spoiler, complete low shaped roof fin and dark raised longitudinal rails. Keep their real scale and source form, without a taller fin, long rod, crossbars, enlarged wing or new exhausts. The final must remain a front view, not this rear camera. Image 3 is only a front-structure reference for the kidney boundaries, vertical-plus-diagonal strip topology, headlamp shape and corner L geometry. Never transfer its silver wheels, mirror finish, body paint, brighter chrome corner coating, roof or accessories. Do not copy a patch of its pixels into a different-camera image.

Preserve the primary car’s shape and equipment while changing the reflected scene. Remove all identifiable shop lettering, orange and turquoise signs, trees, people, neighboring cars, window grids, paving and street reflections from the paint, glass, mirrors and grille. Replace the environmental mapping with clean, nonrecognizable soft studio highlights. Keep the actual deep navy/near-black glossy metallic clearcoat, polished sheen and natural highlight transitions; do not make it matte, satin, flat black or another color. The upper grille must be clean of shop reflections while retaining its actual dark structure and finish. Remove all background and plate characters, keeping a plain blue plate of the actual shape. Retain the primary car’s window state, quiet orange cabin and physical factory details; no people or added model text.

Deliver the entire car on true transparent RGBA. All tires, mirrors, roof fin, rails, spoiler and bumper corners must be inside the frame, with at least 80 pixels of transparent space above and on either side and 100 pixels below the tires. The car should occupy about 78 percent of the canvas width. No floor, cast or contact shadow, halo, checkerboard, watermark or caption. These are 1920-pixel published derivatives, not master originals. Do not invent hidden trim or stretch the car to dimensional numbers.
